intent_contract.text: 이렇게 3개 주제로 아까와 같은 방식으로 테스트해줘.

An independent single-image low-angle photographic test, using the supplied portrait for visible face and hair appearance. Low angle means a viewpoint below the subject looking upward, evidenced by projection rather than a label.

A single photographic test scene presents an adult fictional woman in a glass-roofed conservatory with iron ribs. Use the attached portrait as a facial and hair appearance reference: the visible dark chin-length bob, airy fringe, soft face contour, dark eyes and natural skin texture inform this invented adult character. One exposure catches a visible working moment. She stands beside a narrow weathered galvanized-metal potting bench, her right palm pressing a folded cloth against its vertical near edge and wiping a wet streak along that edge; her left hand cradles a spare towel bundle at her waist. Both boot soles rest on the stone floor, feet staggered, with her torso upright and elbows softly bent. Her linen overshirt and straight trousers follow the posture. The viewpoint is below the subject's waist and directed upward. The underside of her chin and overhead roof ribs are visible. Near boots appear larger than her head as the body recedes upward. Vertical iron columns converge toward the upper frame. A portrait-oriented full-body photograph includes the floor contacts, cloth-to-edge contact and tall glass canopy in one connected view. Cool overcast daylight enters through the open side, separating the face and hands from the ironwork with gentle tonal contrast. Damp metal, folded cloth and stone remain tactile and distinct.
